    FROM driver_season
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT round) >= 2
),
first_race_constructors AS (
    SELECT ds.year, ds.driver_id, ds.constructor_id
    FROM driver_season ds
    JOIN driver_season_stats dss ON ds.year = dss.year AND ds.driver_id = dss.driver_id AND ds.round = dss.first_round
),
last_race_constructors AS (
    SELECT ds.year, ds.driver_id, ds.constructor_id
    FROM driver_season ds
    JOIN driver_season_stats dss ON ds.year = dss.year AND ds.driver_id = dss.driver_id AND ds.round = dss.last_round
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname
FROM driver_season_stats dss
JOIN first_race_constructors frc ON dss.year = frc.year AND dss.driver_id = frc.driver_id
JOIN last_race_constructors lrc ON dss.year = lrc.year AND dss.driver_id = lrc.driver_id AND frc.constructor_id = lrc.constructor_id
JOIN f1.main.drivers d ON dss.driver_id = d.driver_id
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename;
